comment: Worked out by hand (mitcad#469): a circle of radius 5 about the z axis swept 40 up along it, guided by an arc of radius 42.5 about (-32.5, 0, 20) from (5, 0, 0) to (5, 0, 40) that bulges out to x = 10 at z = 20. The rail's point at height z is where it crosses the plane z (the plane square to the path), at the distance y(z) = sqrt(42.5^2 - (z - 20)^2) - 32.5 from the path, and the circle scales with it to the radius y(z): V = pi * integral of y^2 over z = pi (2862.5 * 40 - 16000 / 3 - 65 (750 + 1806.25 asin(8/17))) = 9087.4159. (The rail's point at the same fraction of its length would give 20 pi (3918.75 - 1850 / asin(8/17)) = 8979.3605.)
